Capital Goods Capital Enabled.role: v7.7.4 Construction Materials plant-capital master switch (value 1).
Capital Goods Capital Enabled.effect: 0 preserves Modes 0-33 exactly; 1 makes production capacity read lifecycle plant active capacity and enables plant expansion demand/sinks.

Capital Goods Plant Operating Reserve Fa.role: Construction Materials plant lifecycle parameter, value 1.1.
Capital Goods Plant Operating Reserve Fa.effect: Scales smoothed demand signal into required active plant capacity.
Capital Goods Plant Operating Reserve Fa.evidence: V7_7_4_ARCHITECTURE_SPEC §2; owner-defined value verified on the pre-issue skeleton.

Capital Goods Plant Installed Reserve Fa.role: Construction Materials plant lifecycle parameter, value 1.15.
Capital Goods Plant Installed Reserve Fa.effect: Scales required active capacity into desired installed plant capacity.
Capital Goods Plant Installed Reserve Fa.evidence: V7_7_4_ARCHITECTURE_SPEC §2; owner-defined value verified on the pre-issue skeleton.

A Capital Goods Plant Installed Capacity.role: Initial installed capital-goods plant capacity for colony A, value 2.
A Capital Goods Plant Installed Capacity.effect: Seeds lifecycle capital at the previously accepted base production capacity; A/B are intentionally asymmetric (2 vs 1).
A Capital Goods Plant Installed Capacity.evidence: V7_7_4_ARCHITECTURE_SPEC §2 explicitly requires A=2, B=1 and mandatory annotation of the asymmetric pair.

A Capital Goods Plant Active Capacity.role: Initial active capital-goods plant capacity for colony A, value 2.
A Capital Goods Plant Active Capacity.effect: Starts active equal to installed capacity, preserving the prior base-capacity level before lifecycle adjustment; A/B are intentionally asymmetric (2 vs 1).
A Capital Goods Plant Active Capacity.evidence: V7_7_4_ARCHITECTURE_SPEC §2; same specified initial A/B capacities as Installed.

B Capital Goods Plant Installed Capacity.role: Initial installed capital-goods plant capacity for colony B, value 1.
B Capital Goods Plant Installed Capacity.effect: Seeds lifecycle capital at the previously accepted base production capacity; A/B are intentionally asymmetric (2 vs 1).
B Capital Goods Plant Installed Capacity.evidence: V7_7_4_ARCHITECTURE_SPEC §2 explicitly requires A=2, B=1 and mandatory annotation of the asymmetric pair.

B Capital Goods Plant Active Capacity.role: Initial active capital-goods plant capacity for colony B, value 1.
B Capital Goods Plant Active Capacity.effect: Starts active equal to installed capacity, preserving the prior base-capacity level before lifecycle adjustment; A/B are intentionally asymmetric (2 vs 1).
B Capital Goods Plant Active Capacity.evidence: V7_7_4_ARCHITECTURE_SPEC §2; same specified initial A/B capacities as Installed.

Capital Goods Demand Signal Adjustment T.role: Capital Goods demand-signal adjustment time, value 3 days.
Capital Goods Demand Signal Adjustment T.effect: Controls lag between instantaneous Capital Goods demand and the plant sizing signal; this lag breaks the same-step demand -> required capacity -> desired expansion -> demand loop.
Capital Goods Demand Signal Adjustment T.evidence: V7_7_4_ARCHITECTURE_SPEC §1–§2; owner skeleton uses the established demand-signal idiom.

A Capital Goods Demand Signal.role: Initial smoothed Capital Goods demand signal for colony A, value 0.13.
A Capital Goods Demand Signal.effect: Seeds the lagged plant-sizing signal at day-0 demand instead of feeding instantaneous demand into Required Active Capacity.

B Capital Goods Demand Signal.role: Initial smoothed Capital Goods demand signal for colony B, value 0.13.
B Capital Goods Demand Signal.effect: Seeds the lagged plant-sizing signal at day-0 demand instead of feeding instantaneous demand into Required Active Capacity.
